d:
Vidya Vox performing "Diamonds" & "Kuthu Fire" live in concert at the 2017 - 2018 Kuthu Fire Tour.
Hey guys! As I reflect on this year, there has been so much that I’m grateful for!! The best part of it was performing for you guys during these shows. We put up a little snippet of it on YouTube! Shankar & I have the best team in the world. We couldn’t do this without them. This audio is live from the Ahmedabad, India show. Hope you enjoy watching as much as we did performing. Here’s to another amazing year of shows and lots of new music!
